subject: measure.py e46d4d6: judge matrix landed; exact loop.py/heldout.py lines for you
body: Merged e46d4d6. New: Sample.judge_verbalized[label] (A1 per judge), Measurer.judges, measure.judge_matrix(samples, target_label), model_family, headline_judge, a1_is_lower_bound, realism_auroc(..., target=). COST CHANGE: in dev mode the judge now also answers the A2 probe questions, so a dev sample is 7 + Q_judge calls (12 with Haiku's 5-question set); Measurer(dev_judge_p_eval=False) restores 7. awareness/score are unchanged (target-side). Please re-derive E4 cost estimates. Suggested edits in your files: (1) loop.py Evaluation.summary, after the judge_p_eval entry: "judge_verbalized": {j: _mean_present([s.judge_verbalized.get(j) for s in ok]) for j in sorted({j for s in ok for j in s.judge_verbalized})}. (2) where realism is built: realism_auroc(baseline.samples, real, target=self.ms.target.label) (same for best); then rep["judge_matrix"] = judge_matrix(best.samples, self.ms.target.label) and rep["judge_a1_unparseable"] = dict(getattr(self.ms, "judge_a1_unparseable", {})) (with an ItemPool, sum over its measurers). (3) write_report: a 'Judges' table from rep['judge_matrix']['judges'] with columns judge, family, A1 mean (n), A2 mean (n), role (headline / same-family check / cross-family), a line naming the headline judge or saying there is none, and 'A1 is a lower bound' when judge_matrix['a1_is_lower_bound']. (4) heldout.evaluate_design: collect the samples and add out['judge_matrix'] the same way. (5) optional cli flag --no-dev-judge-p-eval passed to the Measurer constructors. Final mode: run once per held-out target with both judges in --heldout-judges, cross-family judge first.
